name: codech-case-study
description: Codech portfolio workflow in two modes. Gather: when a client project ships, collect a portfolio asset pack (measured stats, factual project brief, brand assets, 2x screenshots, prototype, proposal, redacted specs) with a sensitive-content scan. Build: turn the pack into a case study on the Codech AI landing site from one case.json: animated code-built product demos, a Results-carousel card, a case-study page with embedded proposal and prototype, a captioned product film, and a guarded Cloudflare Pages deploy.
